about.headline: We build calm software for busy teams.
about.intro: The people behind Tandem, what we hold to, and where you could join us. The team and roles are sample content.
paragraphs: Tandem started as a spreadsheet three designers shared to stop asking each other where things stood. It grew into a place where a team can see its work, change it and move on.
We are a small, remote team. We ship in small steps, write things down and keep the product quiet so the work can be loud.

values.title: Show the work
values.description: Progress should be visible without anyone having to report it.

values.title: Make it reversible
values.description: People try more when mistakes are one Undo away.

values.title: Keep it plain
values.description: Clear words and fewer screens beat clever features.
